proposals.intro: The AI reads the day's targets and what is already logged, then proposes meal ideas (foods + quantities) that fit within the targets. Food portions are indivisible.

proposals.resultsIntro: Three distinct proposals. The totals shown are for the whole day (already logged + proposal), verified server-side — never read from the AI.

refine.intro: Adjust this proposal: drop a food you don't have, or pin a quantity. The AI re-proposes honouring these constraints and all the day's targets.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.intro: Connect a remote, OpenAI-compatible AI (e.g. Google Gemini or Anthropic Claude).
ai.promptNote: The response format is handled by the app and is not editable here.

help.title: How to connect Gemini (step by step)
help.intro: No technical knowledge needed — just follow these steps:
help.step1: Sign in to Google AI Studio with a Google account (free).
help.step2: Click “Create API key”, then copy the key into the “API key” field above.
help.step3: Click “Use the Gemini URL” under the Base URL field — or paste it yourself: {{url}}
help.step4: Click “Fetch models”, then pick a model for each task — a vision-capable model (e.g. gemini-2.x) for photo analysis.
help.modelNote: A “model” is the AI variant that answers a task.

claude.title: How to connect Claude (step by step)
claude.step1: Sign in to the Anthropic console and open API keys.
claude.step2: Create a key, then copy it into the “API key” field above.
claude.step3: Click “Use the Claude URL” under the Base URL field — or paste it yourself: {{url}}
claude.step4: Click “Fetch models”, then pick a Claude model (e.g. a recent claude-sonnet) for each task.
claude.note: Claude (Anthropic) is billed per token — there is no free tier.

data.title: Data

export.label: Export my data
export.desc: Download a JSON file with all your content (foods, recipes, journal, weigh-ins, targets…), excluding credentials.

import.label: Import an extract
import.desc: Restore a previously exported file. Replaces all your current data with the file's contents.
import.modalBody: All your current content will be permanently replaced by the file's. Your sign-in credentials are unchanged. This cannot be undone.

wipe.label: Delete all my data
wipe.desc: Removes foods, recipes, journal, weigh-ins, targets and containers. Your account, profile and default day structure are kept.
wipe.modalBody: All your content (foods, recipes, days, weigh-ins, targets, containers) will be permanently deleted. Your account, profile and default day structure are kept. This cannot be undone.
